_comment: EGM Downloader Mac update feed. Upload to egerena.com/apps/egmac-update.json
_version_notes: Fixed tooltips across the app — main navigation, Advanced settings, Subscriptions, and more — showing in English regardless of your selected language
Fixed dozens of notifications, status messages, and confirmation dialogs throughout the app also showing in English regardless of language — a deeper follow-up pass after the tooltip fix above
Electron runtime updated to v43.1.1 — includes upstream Chromium and Node.js stability and security updates

notes: Fixed tooltips across the app — main navigation, Advanced settings, Subscriptions, and more — showing in English regardless of your selected language
Fixed dozens of notifications, status messages, and confirmation dialogs throughout the app also showing in English regardless of language — a deeper follow-up pass after the tooltip fix above
Electron runtime updated to v43.1.1 — includes upstream Chromium and Node.js stability and security updates
New in-app language selector — EGM Downloader now speaks 10 languages: English, Arabic, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Portuguese, and Russian
Language auto-detects from your system on first launch, and can be changed anytime from the footer — no restart needed
Language selector can be hidden from Advanced settings for a cleaner footer, and re-enabled anytime
Downloaded subtitles now include your selected app language alongside English (when available for that video)
New opt-in "Upscale to selected quality" — videos smaller than the chosen quality preset are proportionally upscaled to it after download (off by default; adds pixels, not detail)

Video conversion (the "MP4 · H.264" compatibility format and Upscale) now uses your GPU when available, cutting CPU load and heat dramatically — automatically falls back to software encoding if no compatible GPU is found or it's busy

New: HDR downloads — videos with an HDR version (HDR10, HDR10+, HLG, Dolby Vision) now show it as a separate option per resolution. HDR downloads save as MKV to preserve the HDR data untouched (requires an HDR-capable display and player to actually look right)
Fixed Full HD/4K downloads sometimes downloading a smaller video than "Best available" on portrait video (TikTok, Shorts, Reels) — thank you @ligun0510!
Fixed cancelling a video conversion (H.264 fix-up or Upscale) sometimes closing the whole app instead of just that download
Fixed cancel not working during video conversion — clicking Cancel while a video was converting was silently ignored, and the conversion ran to completion anyway
The "Converting…" status now shows which encoder is being used (e.g. "Converting… · h264_nvenc"), so you can confirm hardware acceleration is active
Deno now updates alongside yt-dlp, ffmpeg, and other plugins in Advanced settings, instead of its own separate button
Advanced panel now shows current → latest version for optional libraries and ffmpeg when an update is available, and correctly detects updates after switching ffmpeg channels
Optional libraries (curl-cffi, brotli, pycryptodomex, websockets, certifi) can now be updated in-app from Advanced settings — previously view-only on these platforms
Minor spacing polish — collapsed Subscriptions sidebar thumbnails, and the Update/What's New modals no longer crowd their scrollbar against the text
The download queue in Subscriptions now stays pinned at the top of the sidebar — with a long channel list, it used to scroll out of view
Site Cookies panel in Settings redesigned into a more compact, centered layout
Settings panel (including Site Cookies) can now be hidden from Advanced settings for a cleaner look, same as the language selector
Subscriptions now detects and labels members-only videos (requires the latest yt-dlp stable or nightly — this didn't work on older stable releases)
DMG install window refreshed with a custom background matching the app's theme
Deleting a custom theme now asks for confirmation first — previously deleted instantly with no way to undo
Removed the "Clear cache" button from Advanced settings — it served no real purpose, since temp/partial files are already cleaned up automatically after every download and on every app launch
Fixed an issue where users were attempting to enter the Konami code.

50 new themes added — 500 total. 8 international holidays and 4 memes, a category-balance batch (Dark, Light, Futuristic, Retro), a new "Old Internet" category, and Vehicle History (10 real, 10 fictional)
Backed by 117 automated tests covering security, process safety, and cross-platform consistency — all passing
Fixed ffmpeg process not closing properly when cancelling a download or quitting the app
Fixed the "What's New" update modal never appearing after an update
Fixed "Download All" getting stuck if a queued item was removed mid-run
Fixed queue reorder arrows sometimes moving the wrong item
Fixed a crash when switching a subscription's format after setting a per-video quality override
Fixed audio and video quality selections interfering with each other in some cases
Fixed the History window sometimes keeping the wrong theme colors after switching themes
Fixed a rare issue where importing a history backup could affect files outside the app's folder
Fixed a download getting stuck on "Queued" forever if the save folder became unavailable (e.g. an unplugged drive)
Fixed a download card getting stuck on "Downloading…" if the job was cleared from memory
Fixed the mini History panel permanently hiding half of each batch of entries
Fixed the Deno "Install" button doing nothing
Reinstalling Deno now applies immediately in the background — no restart needed

Fixed MP3/M4A/Opus downloads sometimes saving as VBR (variable bitrate) instead of the selected CBR bitrate — audio tools like MediaInfo, AIMP, and foobar2000 now correctly report the chosen bitrate (reported by @Krezzin, thank you!)
Rebalanced the Audio/Video format dropdowns in Settings so longer video format names display in full instead of getting cut off
Settings and Advanced panels now use a simple arrow instead of "Show"/"Hide" text to indicate expand/collapse state
New Sneakers theme category — 10 themes including Bred, Royal, Panda, and Grinch, plus a tribute pair honoring the shoe this project is named after: Brick by Brick and Brick After Brick
Theme catalog now totals 450 built-in themes
Electron runtime updated to v43.0.0 — includes Chromium and Node.js stability and security updates
New Modern theme category — 20 themes covering internet-culture and lifestyle aesthetics, from Clean Girl and Dark Academia to Algorithm and Y2K Revival
Theme catalog now totals 440 built-in themes
